creeperknight.title: Creeper Knight Settings
creeperknight.status.enterworld: Enter a world to view and edit its settings.
creeperknight.status.confirmblocks: Confirm block damage for scepter knights.
creeperknight.confirm.title: Enable explosive block damage?
creeperknight.confirm.blocks: Scepter knights may destroy buildings. The world's mobGriefing rule must also allow block damage. Confirm saving this setting?
creeperknight.wand.tooltip: Tap right-click to aim and lock a player; hold 1 second to summon.
creeperknight.wand.public: %s was locked by %s using a Friendship-Ending Scepter
creeperknight.wand.warning: Warning: you have been locked by %s
creeperknight.wand.disabled: The server disabled the scepter or player attacks.
creeperknight.wand.cooldown: The scepter is still cooling down.
creeperknight.wand.nolock: Tap right-click to lock a player first.
creeperknight.wand.gunpowder: Summoning requires one gunpowder in your inventory.
creeperknight.wand.space: No safe space ahead, or the selected rider type is disabled.
creeperknight.wand.aim: Aim at a visible survival player in range, then tap right-click.
creeperknight.option.wandEnabled.tooltip: Default: ON. OFF prevents locking and summoning while preserving existing items. The server enforces every rule.
creeperknight.option.wandCraftable.toolt: Default: ON. Craft one from a creeper head, diamond and gold ingot arranged vertically. OFF disables recipe matching; existing items follow the enable switch.
creeperknight.option.wandRiderType.toolt: Click to cycle the five baby zombie families. Default: zombie. The type must be enabled in Riders. Scepter knights pursue only the locked player, including zombified piglin riders.
creeperknight.option.wandLifetimeSeconds: Integer: 0–120, default 30. Starts at summon; explodes on expiry. Death, logout or dimension changes never pause the timer. 0 explodes immediately. Applies to new summons.
creeperknight.option.wandSpeedMultiplier: Range: 1–10, default 1. Relative to ordinary knights at the current movement setting; applies only to scepter summons. Fast knights brake at corners and near their target to avoid circling.
creeperknight.option.wandBlockDamage.too: Default: OFF. OFF prevents block damage from all scepter knight explosions. Enabling requires a second confirmation and mobGriefing must also be ON. Other knights are unaffected.
creeperknight.option.wandNotifications.t: Show all: public notice for observers and private notices for both players. Hide target: omit all notices to the target. Hide all: send no lock chat messages. Outline is configured separately.
creeperknight.option.wandGlowSeconds.too: Integer: 0–120, default 10. Apply vanilla Glowing on lock; other players can see the outline. 0 disables it. Hiding chat does not hide the outline.
creeperknight.option.wandCooldownSeconds: Integer: 0–120, default 10. Cooldown after a successful summon; 0 disables it. A continuous hold summons at most once.
creeperknight.option.wandLockRange.toolt: Range: 2–128, default 32. Initial lock requires aiming without a blocking wall. After locking, the target may run out of range and still be pursued.
creeperknight.option.wandConsumeGunpowde: Default: ON. Successful survival summons consume one inventory gunpowder. Failed summons and creative mode consume none. The scepter is reusable.
creeperknight.gamerule: Block damage follows the world's mobGriefing rule.
creeperknight.status.ready: Changes apply to this world after saving.
creeperknight.status.invalid: Invalid value or save failed. Check ranges in tooltips.
creeperknight.status.denied: Only the world owner or an operator may change settings.
creeperknight.status.readonly: Read only: ask the server operator to change settings.
creeperknight.status.rate: Please wait one second before saving again.
creeperknight.command.help: Press K in a world to open settings. Operators: /creeperknight summon <zombie|husk|drowned|zombie_villager|zombified_piglin>, /creeperknight reload.
creeperknight.command.confirmreload: This enables block damage from scepter knights. Confirm possible building damage with /creeperknight reload confirm within 30 seconds.
creeperknight.option.zombie.tooltip: Allow baby zombies to control creepers. Default: ON.
creeperknight.option.husk.tooltip: Allow baby husks to control creepers. Default: ON.
creeperknight.option.drowned.tooltip: Allow baby drowned to control creepers. Default: ON.
creeperknight.option.zombieVillager.tool: Allow baby zombie villagers to control creepers. Default: ON.
creeperknight.option.zombifiedPiglin.too: Allow baby zombified piglins to control creepers. Default: ON. Neutral riders do not make their creepers hostile.
creeperknight.option.naturalSpawning.too: Give naturally spawned, eligible babies a chance to spawn on a creeper. Existing chicken jockeys are preserved. Default: ON.
creeperknight.option.naturalChance.toolt: Range: 0–1. 0.01 = 1% of eligible naturally spawned babies without a mount. Default: 0.01. Does not change baby spawn odds.
creeperknight.option.seekMounts.tooltip: Idle, unmounted babies can walk to a nearby free creeper and mount it. Default: ON.
creeperknight.option.seekChance.tooltip: Range: 0–1. Rolled once per search interval while idle. 0.01 = 1%. Default: 0.01.
creeperknight.option.seekIntervalTicks.t: Integer range: 20–12000. 20 ticks = 1 second. Default: 200 (10 seconds).
creeperknight.option.seekRange.tooltip: Range: 2–32 blocks. Chooses the nearest visible, unoccupied, unignited creeper. Default: 8.
creeperknight.option.mountDistance.toolt: Range: 0.5–3, no greater than search radius. Babies walk into this distance before mounting. Default: 2.
creeperknight.option.speedMultiplier.too: Range: 0.1–4, default 1.5. Multiplies mounted movement speed. Fast knights brake at corners and near their target to avoid circling. Removed when the rider is gone.
creeperknight.option.fullAiTakeover.tool: Default: ON. A neutral rider prevents proximity ignition. OFF: a nearby survival player can trigger the fuse, without autonomous pursuit. Flint and steel works in both modes.
creeperknight.option.chaseDuringFuse.too: Default: ON. Continue following the rider's AI during the automatic fuse countdown. OFF: stop navigation during countdown. Only applies when instant explosion is OFF.
creeperknight.option.instantExplosion.to: Default: OFF. ON: replace the automatic countdown with an immediate vanilla explosion at the configured distance from a visible, allowed target. Hostility and AI takeover settings still apply. Flint and steel keeps its vanilla countdown.
creeperknight.option.instantExplosionDis: Range: 0.5–16 blocks, decimals allowed. Default: 2. Explode immediately at or within this distance; no automatic countdown outside it. Only used when instant explosion is ON. Ordinary countdown distances stay vanilla.
creeperknight.disabled.instant: Unavailable: instant explosion replaces the automatic countdown.
creeperknight.disabled.distance: Enable instant explosion to edit its distance.
creeperknight.option.attackPlayers.toolt: Allow the rider's existing player target and partial-mode proximity ignition. Default: ON. Flint and steel still works when OFF.
creeperknight.option.attackVillagers.too: Allow existing targets that are villagers or wandering traders. Does not give neutral riders a new target. Default: ON.
creeperknight.option.attackIronGolems.to: Allow the rider's existing iron golem target. Does not create new hostility. Default: ON.
Allow any other living target selected by the rider's vanilla AI. Never adds new targets. Default: ON.
